editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FXGT scores 5.8 out of 10 from NAFT in May 2026. It offers genuinely competitive ECN spreads and strong crypto integration, but no Tier-1 regulator covers retail clients. The CySEC licence is institutional-only. Unresolved complaint volumes are a concern, and two non-Tier-1 regulators have flagged the brand for unlicensed activity. Legitimate broker with real licences — but the protection gap between what is advertised and what retail traders actually receive is the story here.
